character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Gender-neutral base template character for an isometric tactics RPG, in the style of Final Fantasy Tactics and Ragnarok Online sprites with an anime face. Androgynous young adult, about 3.5 heads tall (not chibi). Neutral slim body: medium shoulders, straight torso, no defined waist, slim arms and legs. Soft neutral anime face: medium-sized eyes, small nose, small mouth, no strong jaw. Very short, close-cropped dark-brown hair that hugs the head. Clothes are skin-tight and body-fitting, like a plain base suit: a fitted light grey short-sleeved top that follows the body's shape with no loose fabric or folds, and fitted dark grey shorts (not blue) that hug the thighs. Bare feet, light warm skin. No accessories, armour or weapon. Relaxed standing pose, arms at the sides. Soft hand-painted pixel shading, warm muted tones, dark warm outline, light from the top-left.
